Model questions

MPJSC1500 FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the MPJSC1500?

The stated rated capacity is 1,500 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the MPJSC1500?

The listed lift specification is 85-800 mm fork height. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the MPJSC1500?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
